# powerbash

> A powerline-style bash prompt in pure bash. One script you source into your
> shell — no dependencies, no daemon, no patched fonts, no root. Runs on Linux,
> macOS, and WSL, on bash 3.2 and newer.

powerbash shows the git branch and its state, the path, the return code of the
last command, and a handful of other segments, directly in `PS1`. Every segment
is a `POWERBASH_*` environment variable; the `powerbash` command sets them and
`powerbash config save` persists them to `~/.config/powerbashrc`.

Install with `brew install powerbash/powerbash/powerbash`, or
`curl -s https://get.powerbash.org | bash` on machines without Homebrew.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://powerbash.org/docs/): install, every subcommand, the
  configuration variables, performance on slow filesystems, and uninstalling.
- [Requirements](https://powerbash.org/docs/#requirements): bash 3.2+, a UTF-8
  locale, and optionally `tput` and `git`.
- [Install](https://powerbash.org/docs/#install): Homebrew, the install script,
  or by hand. All three install into your own account and need no root.
- [Configuration variables](https://powerbash.org/docs/#configuration): the full
  table of `POWERBASH_*` variables, their accepted values, and their defaults.
- [Saving settings](https://powerbash.org/docs/#saving): `powerbash config
  save|load|default`, and why the config file is parsed rather than sourced.
- [Performance on slow filesystems](https://powerbash.org/docs/#performance):
  `git skip` and `git timeout`, for WSL and network mounts.
- [Uninstall](https://powerbash.org/docs/#uninstall)

## Agent skills

- [powerbash skill](https://powerbash.org/.well-known/agent-skills/powerbash/SKILL.md):
  installing and configuring powerbash on a user's machine.
- [Skills index](https://powerbash.org/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)

## Source

- [Source repository](https://github.com/napalm255/powerbash): the script itself,
  plus `AGENTS.md` describing the architecture and the constraints on changes.
- [Download](https://download.powerbash.org/powerbash.sh): the current
  `powerbash.sh`, served verbatim.
- [Install script](https://get.powerbash.org): served verbatim; it is both the
  web page and the script.
- [Homebrew tap](https://github.com/napalm255/homebrew-powerbash)
- [Issues](https://github.com/napalm255/powerbash/issues)

## Optional

- [Multi-user installs](https://powerbash.org/docs/#global): possible via
  `/etc/profile.d/`, discouraged, and Linux only. Explains the `z_` filename
  prefix and the `PROMPT_COMMAND` ordering race it works around.
- [term](https://powerbash.org/docs/#term): for when you SSH into a machine that
  does not have your terminal's terminfo entry and the colors disappear.
